method: shipped VIs run headless through LabVIEW's ActiveX server; inputs were chosen by the author, outputs copied unchanged

write_string.json.how: writeUserModePref.vi (resource/modes/shared), which calls Write Key (String), given 'value'; 'line' is the key line LabVIEW wrote under [LabVIEW]

read_string.json.how: GPFW NI_ReadToken_String.vi (resource/plugins/NewDialogFiles/ProjectWizards/GenProjFrameWork), which calls Read Key (String), reading each 'line' from a [S] section of a CRLF file (latin-1 bytes); 'value' is what LabVIEW returned

rewrite.json.how: writeUserModePref.vi writing LVMode = "new" under [LabVIEW] into a file holding 'before'; 'after' is the whole file LabVIEW wrote back. In the case escapes_kept the quoted value q holds raw NUL and 0x12 characters, which LabVIEW writes back unchanged

read_typed.json.how:
path and I32 cases: Read FW INI.vi (vi.lib/MakerHub/LINX/Private/Utilties), which calls Read Key (Path) for FirmwareRelPath and Read Key (I32) for FlashTimeout, on a file '[Firmware]
FirmwareRelPath = <path stored>
FlashTimeout = <int stored>
'; error 0 means no error, then 'value' is LabVIEW's reading. Boolean cases: GPFW NI_ReadToken_Bool.vi read with default TRUE and with default FALSE; null means LabVIEW returned the default both times (not a boolean to it). Double cases: examples/File IO/Configuration (INI)/Read Configuration (INI) File.vi with front-panel datalogging, the Double key holding 'stored'; values are Python reprs of the logged DBL; spellings LabVIEW refused (it raised its error dialog) are not listed

write_example.json.how: examples/File IO/Configuration (INI)/Write Configuration (INI) File.vi run with its default front panel on a Windows system whose decimal separator is a comma; 'file' is the whole file LabVIEW wrote

read_semantics.json.how: GPFW NI_ReadToken_String.vi asked for each (section, key) of 'lookups' in a CRLF file holding 'file'; 'value' and 'found' are what LabVIEW returned, '<absent>' being the default value passed in

read_more.json.how: a second run on 2026-10-13 with the same VIs: 'strings' are GPFW NI_ReadToken_String.vi lookups of (section, key) in a CRLF file holding 'file' ('<absent>' is the default passed in); 'bools' GPFW NI_ReadToken_Bool.vi on [S] k = <stored>, null when LabVIEW returned its default; 'paths' and 'ints' Read FW INI.vi as in read_typed.json, error 19 meaning LabVIEW refused the number; 'rewrite' writeUserModePref.vi writing LVMode = 'value' ("new" when absent) into a file holding 'before'

read_third.json.how: a third run on 2026-10-13 with the same VIs and the same shapes as read_more.json, on cases written by an independent reviewer, 320 of the string lookups generated from seed 424242: accented letter case, header-like lines, indented headers, stored codes in typed and path reads

observed: read_semantics.json: Read Key matches section and key names without regard to case.
read_semantics.json: Read Key sees only the first block of a repeated section and the first line of a repeated key.
read_semantics.json: Read Key does not see keys placed before the first section header.
read_semantics.json: Read Key reads a line with no '=' as a key with an empty value.
read_semantics.json and read_string.json: Read Key treats ';' in an unquoted value as the start of a comment and returns a rejoined text, not the value as written.
read_string.json: Read Key trims spaces and tabs around values, nothing else; inside quotes they are kept.
